name: server-k8s-api-extract
title: Extract server_k8s_api.py from server_ops.py
description: Epic step 5: extract the pure Kubernetes REST-facade builder/filter/format layer (discovery/OpenAPI-structural/kubeconfig + _k8s_api_resource_list + response builders + selector/namespace filters + non-snapshot mutation-parse + request-body readers) from server_ops.py into the one-way leaf server_k8s_api.py (with the _api_* trace/redaction sink in server_k8s_api_trace.py) using the legacy.py role-swap pattern. The resource_snapshot-bound dispatch spine (kubernetes_api_response, _k8s_objects_for_resource, mutating/group/core/resource dispatchers, OpenAPI document builders) stays in server_ops.py.
